items.requirement: Identify the report as a systematic review.
Provide a structured systematic-review abstract.
Explain the rationale in the context of existing knowledge.
State explicit review objectives or questions.
Specify eligibility criteria and synthesis grouping rules.
Identify every information source and its last search date.
Provide complete source-specific search strategies, filters, and limits.
Describe selection methods, reviewer independence, and automation.
Describe data collection, confirmation, independence, and automation.
Define sought outcomes and result-selection rules.
Define other variables and assumptions for missing information.
Describe risk-of-bias tools, independence, and automation.
Specify effect measures for each outcome.
Describe how studies were assigned to syntheses.
Describe data preparation and conversions.
Describe tabular or visual display methods.
Describe and justify synthesis models, heterogeneity assessment, and software.
Describe planned exploration of heterogeneity.
Describe sensitivity-analysis methods.
Describe assessment of bias from missing results.
Describe certainty-assessment methods.
Report record-to-study selection counts.
Cite plausibly eligible excluded studies and their reasons.
Cite included studies and report their characteristics.
Report risk-of-bias judgments for each included study.
Report study-level group summaries, effects, and precision.
Summarize characteristics and bias of studies contributing to each synthesis.
Report every synthesis estimate, precision, heterogeneity, and direction.
Report investigations of heterogeneity.
Report sensitivity-analysis results.
Report assessments of bias from missing results.
Report certainty for every assessed outcome.
Interpret results in relation to other evidence.
Discuss limitations of the included evidence.
Discuss limitations of review methods.
Discuss implications for practice, policy, and research.
Provide registration details or declare non-registration.
Provide protocol access or state that none exists.
Describe and explain amendments.
Declare financial and non-financial support and sponsor roles.
Declare competing interests.
Report availability of forms, extracted data, analysis data, code, and other materials.
